profile.summary: Sonic is a telecommunications company and internet service provider that offers fiber-optic internet, phone service and colocation to homes and businesses. It operates as a competitive local exchange carrier in parts of California and other states. It began in Santa Rosa, California, in 1994.

review.notes: Sonic.net, LLC is a Santa Rosa ISP and CLEC that sells fiber and dark fiber, which fits 'Sonic Net, LLC' and a Dark Fiber services agreement with OUSD Technology Services; the cited Wikipedia and sonic.com/about pages support the legal name, summary, HQ, website and phone. The OUSD press claim and the San Ramon office were not independently confirmed, but nothing conflicts and the summary is neutral and sourced.
